scope: Issue analysis for GCWeb topic page doormats.
precondition: Run this analysis only when AIDA heuristics have detected one or more doormat items. Missing doormat-section detection is handled before invoking this skill.

selectors.expected_item: section with heading link and paragraph description

issue_categories.label: Incorrect doormat structure
issue_categories.condition: A doormat does not use the expected GCWeb wrapper, column, section, heading link, and paragraph description structure.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use the GCWeb doormat structure: container, column, section, heading link, and one paragraph description.

issue_categories.label: Missing link text
issue_categories.condition: The doormat has no link text or only empty/placeholder text.
issue_categories.recommendation: Add descriptive link text that summarizes the destination page.

issue_categories.label: Non-descriptive link text
issue_categories.condition: The link text is vague, generic, duplicated, or does not indicate what users can find or do.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use action verbs or concise keywords that summarize the destination page's information or tasks.

issue_categories.label: Link text too long
issue_categories.condition: The link text exceeds 75 characters, or exceeds the 45-character preferred length without a strong reason.
issue_categories.recommendation: Shorten the link text. Aim for 45 characters or fewer and do not exceed 75 characters.

issue_categories.label: Link text has trailing punctuation
issue_categories.condition: The link text ends with a period, colon, question mark, exclamation mark, semicolon, or comma.
issue_categories.recommendation: Remove trailing punctuation from the link text.

issue_categories.label: Inconsistent title style
issue_categories.condition: Doormat link texts mix grammatical styles, such as nouns, actions, audiences, or products in the same set.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use one title style across the set, such as all noun topics or all action phrases.

issue_categories.label: Missing description
issue_categories.condition: The doormat has no paragraph description.
issue_categories.recommendation: Add a short description that helps users decide whether the linked page is relevant.

issue_categories.label: Description too long
issue_categories.condition: The description exceeds 120 characters, or exceeds the 100-character preferred length without a strong reason.
issue_categories.recommendation: Shorten the description. Aim for fewer than 100 characters and do not exceed 120 characters.

issue_categories.label: Generic description
issue_categories.condition: The description uses broad reusable text that does not distinguish this doormat from others.
issue_categories.recommendation: Make the description specific to the destination page, audience, benefit, service, or task.

issue_categories.label: Description repeats link text
issue_categories.condition: The description repeats the same words or meaning already present in the link text.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use the description to add distinct decision-making information instead of repeating the title.

issue_categories.label: Description starts with an introductory phrase
issue_categories.condition: The description starts with phrases such as Includes, Information on, Learn more about, Find information about, or similar filler.
issue_categories.recommendation: Start directly with keywords, tasks, eligibility, services, or page-specific information.

issue_categories.label: Description has trailing punctuation
issue_categories.recommendation: Remove final punctuation from the description.

issue_categories.label: Description contains markup or links
issue_categories.condition: The paragraph description contains links, bold text, bullets, or other markup.
issue_categories.recommendation: Keep the description as plain text in a single paragraph.

issue_categories.label: Duplicate or near-duplicate description
issue_categories.condition: Two or more doormats have identical or nearly identical descriptions.
issue_categories.recommendation: Rewrite each description so users can tell the doormats apart.

issue_categories.label: Inconsistent description style
issue_categories.condition: Descriptions mix comma-separated keywords, complete sentences, task phrases, eligibility summaries, or marketing-style language inconsistently.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use one description style across the set, preferably concise comma-separated keywords or task phrases.

issue_categories.label: Promotional language
issue_categories.condition: The doormat uses promotional, persuasive, or marketing-style wording instead of neutral service information.
issue_categories.recommendation: Use neutral, task-focused language that describes what users can find or do.

severity_guidance.High: Blocks users from understanding or using the doormat correctly, or makes doormats indistinguishable.
severity_guidance.Medium: Reduces clarity, scannability, consistency, or compliance with GCWeb guidance.
severity_guidance.Low: Minor style or cleanup issue that should be fixed when editing the doormat.
